Lord Jesus, Christ the King, as we close this Church year, bless our community and every home represented here. Reign gently in our hearts and keep us united in faith, generous in service, and steadfast in your love. Guide our steps as we look toward a new beginning in Advent, and help us serve one another with peace, mercy, and humble love. Amen.

Special thanks as well to Meave Eustace for giving a talk at our local brewery, and to everyone who came along to support! YOUTH 2000 CHRISTMAS RETREAT 11th-13th Dec 2026. Calling all young people aged 16 –35! Join us at the Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat in Newbridge College, Co. Kildare. This is a donation-only event, with free buses available across the country and all meals included. Expect inspiring talks and workshops, Mass, music, prayer, and plenty of opportunities to chill out and meet other young Catholics. Whether you are new to the faith or looking to be refreshed, all are welcome. To register or find out more visit youth2000.ie or follow @Youth2000Ireland.
